facts.text: The user requested information about electric utilities operating in Liberia across the electricity supply chain segments of generation, project use wholesaling, wholesale marketing, transmission, and distribution.
The user requested the number of utilities in each of the specified electricity supply chain segments in Liberia.
The user requested identification of public and/or private electric utilities, including IPPs, operating in Liberia.
The user requested that the response include references.
The user requested the response be written as a detailed academic essay in response to the prompt.
